cases.title: CDSURVEY on a drawing with no survey Xref says so, a wrong pick is refused, and nothing is stored
cases.plan_item: Survey intake (triage group V1; daily card D26 survey half)
cases.expected: CDSURVEY says 'Current survey: Survey: not loaded' and asks for the survey Xref. A pick of the pit P3 (a block, not an Xref) is refused with a sentence and stores no survey; asking again still says 'Survey: not loaded'; Esc prints 'CDSURVEY cancelled - nothing stored.'; the object count and the file on disk do not change.
cases.why_not_unit: The prompts and the stored survey record are seen only in a live drawing.
not_automated: THE WHOLE INTAKE IS NOT DRIVEN: no synthetic survey Xref (millimetre and metre hosts, outliers, levels kept) exists as a drawing, so BUG-699 to BUG-709 and BUG-134, BUG-142, BUG-144 are NOT proved here. Only 'a refusal stores nothing' is.

cases.title: CDDESIGN opens the Design window on its Start tab, says how many things are set, and closes without writing anything
cases.plan_item: CDDESIGN draft (triage group D1; engineering-judgement items stay with Tim)
cases.expected: CDDESIGN prints '[CE] 2 of 6 things this design needs are set.'; the window shows five tabs (Start, Setup, Areas and route, Results, During), the line 'Start with the job and its sources. Save a draft when you are ready.' and 'Land use not set.'; closing it leaves no CE window and the drawing file unchanged.

Only the start of the route is checked.
